theater: 都柏林郵政局與四法院區

battle.name: 復活節起義
battle.theater: 都柏林郵政局與四法院區
battle.brief: 一九一六年四月二十四日復活節星期一，愛爾蘭義勇軍與公民軍在都柏林同時起兵，奪取郵政局與四法院等要點，挑戰駐愛爾蘭英軍與皇家愛爾蘭警察，至四月二十九日被平定。起義者的槍枝以李-恩菲爾德與德造毛瑟為主，僅少數分隊配到法國雷管步槍這類過時的單發前裝槍，射速與瞄準性能都應付不了市區街壘戰。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰雙方是英國與愛爾蘭起義者。英國一方以駐愛爾蘭的英國陸軍為骨幹，另有皇家愛爾蘭警察與都柏林都會警察承擔治安；起義爆發時都柏林駐軍不足三千人，其後由英格蘭與英國北部調來的增援使英軍與警察總數增至六千人左右。英方指揮體系以一名陸軍中將為最高，下分兩個軍區，軍區下轄旅，旅下設營；市區守備由步兵營、第四皇家愛爾蘭龍騎近衛團與皇家野炮兵分擔，警察則依街段分署管理。愛爾蘭一方是兩個非正規武裝：愛爾蘭義勇軍一九一三年十一月成立，全國約一千九百人，都柏林約一千三百人，編為縱隊與營，都柏林縱隊下轄三個營；愛爾蘭公民軍同年由詹姆斯・康諾利與詹姆斯・拉金組織，隸屬愛爾蘭運輸與一般工人聯盟，全國會員上萬，都柏林僅二百五十人左右，分成四個連。此外北愛爾蘭反對自治的志願軍站在英方一邊，正是英軍北部部隊被抽調南下，雙方兵力對比才逐漸傾斜。德國政府是愛爾蘭一方的幕後支援者：湯瑪士・克拉克經艾克斯金・奇爾德斯與哈里・博蘭在德國購買軍火，一九一六年三月底運載步槍的船隻在都柏林北岸被英軍巡邏隊攔截，軍火未能送達起義者手中。
countriesEn: The two sides were the British state and the Irish insurgents. On the British side the backbone was the British Army in Ireland, with the Royal Irish Constabulary and the Dublin Metropolitan Police responsible for public order. When the Rising began the military and police in Dublin numbered fewer than three thousand; reinforcements sent from England and from the north of Ireland later raised the combined total to roughly six thousand. The British command ran under a lieutenant-general, below him two army districts, then brigades and battalions. The defence of the city was shared by infantry battalions, the 4th Royal Irish Dragoon Guards and the Royal Field Artillery, while the police administered the city district by district. The Irish side consisted of two non-regular forces. The Irish Volunteers, founded in November 1913, counted about nineteen hundred men in Ireland and about thirteen hundred in Dublin, organised into brigades and battalions, with three battalions under the Dublin Brigade. The Irish Citizen Army, organised in the same month by James Connolly and James Larkin and affiliated to the Irish Transport and General Workers' Union, had tens of thousands of members across the country but only about two hundred and fifty in Dublin, split into four companies. The Ulster Volunteer Force stood on the British side, and it was the transfer of British troops from the north that gradually tilted the balance of numbers. Germany was the hidden sponsor of the Irish side: Thomas Clarke bought arms in Germany through Erskine Childers and Harry Boland, and the ship carrying the rifles was intercepted by a British patrol off the coast north of Dublin at the end of March 1916, so the arms never reached the insurgents.
people: 起義的領導層集中在少數人身上。帕特里克・皮爾斯是共和國宣言的主要起草人，時任伊頓中學歷史教師，起義前曾數度入獄，四月二十四日下午在郵政局門廊宣讀宣言，三十三歲在停火後被槍決。詹姆斯・康諾利受過英軍正規訓練，參加過南非戰爭與英國愛爾蘭護衛隊，是起義中唯一具正規軍旅經驗的指揮者；星期一他在環形路的工會會堂對公民軍演說並被推為指揮者，星期二夜才與皮爾斯接頭，此後幾乎每個關鍵決策都有他的份額，四月五日傷重去世，三十四歲。湯瑪士・麥克多納是詩人兼學者，與皮爾斯、普倫提特同為宣言簽署人，三十七歲在五月十二日被槍決。喬瑟夫・普倫提特自一九一三年起推動義勇軍的武裝化。湯瑪士・克拉克負責武器籌措與德國方面的聯絡，肖恩・麥克迪爾馬達在一九一五年秘密返國。艾蒙・德瓦萊拉當時在美國募兵，預先在宣言上簽名，未能參與起義。艾蒙・肯特率第三營奪下四法院；麥可・歐拉希利在起義前三小時於多內戈爾街中重傷退出戰鬥；凱瑟爾・布魯哈是郵政局最後的守軍指揮官，撤退後傷重身亡。英方則由都柏林防區各營指揮官、龍騎近衛團團長與主持最後包圍的炮兵指揮官主導。
peopleEn: The leadership of the Rising was concentrated in very few hands. Patrick Pearse was the principal author of the Republic Proclamation and a history teacher at the school he had attended; he had been imprisoned several times before the Rising, read the Proclamation from the steps of the GPO on the afternoon of the twenty-fourth, and was shot at thirty-three after the fighting stopped. James Connolly had been trained in the British Army, had served in the South African war and in the King's Royal Rifle Corps, and was the only commander in the Rising with regular service. On the Monday he addressed the Citizen Army at the union hall on the Circular Road and was acclaimed as commander; only on the Tuesday night did he make contact with Pearse, after which he had a hand in virtually every important decision, and he died of his wounds on the fifth of April at thirty-four. Thomas MacDonagh, a poet and scholar, signed the Proclamation with Pearse and Plunkett and was shot on the twelfth of May at thirty-seven. Joseph Plunkett had driven the arming of the Volunteers since 1913. Thomas Clarke handled the procurement of weapons and the contact with Germany, and Seán MacDiarmada came home in secret in 1915. Éamon de Valera was then raising money and recruits in the United States and had signed the Proclamation in advance, so he took no part in the Rising. Éamon Ceannt led the Third Battalion in the seizure of the Four Courts. Michael O'Rahilly was badly wounded in Donegall Street three hours before the Rising began and dropped out of the fighting. Cathal Brugha commanded the last garrison of the Post Office and died of his wounds after the evacuation. On the British side the operations were directed by the commanders of the Dublin garrison battalions, the officer commanding the Dragoon Guards, and the artillery commander who directed the final cordon.
kits: 任務單上的法國一八四〇年雷管步槍，是這場起義裝備體系裡最舊的一端。它是單發、膛線、前裝的步槍，槍口裝填、逐發壓入雷管底火，憑雷管取代火燧，最大的優點是濕霧天氣底火仍能擊發——四月二十四日星期一上午的都柏林狂風暴雨，正是這種老槍少數還能保證的可靠性能。它由一八四〇年制式一路演到一八七四年格拉斯式，一八九〇年代之後已從歐洲軍隊退到殖民警衛與民間存量；到一九一六年，義勇軍與公民軍手中仍留著一批這類過時雷管步槍，多來自十九世紀的共和派舊庫與退伍軍人俱樂部存槍，分給未受射擊訓練或遲遲未配到新槍的分隊。真正吃重的是近代栓動步槍：一九一四年六月在霍斯向英軍退伍士官購得的一千五百支李-恩菲爾德式後膛步槍，同年秋由印度軍械庫購得的約一千九百支毛瑟式步槍，再加上三月被截的那批德造步槍未能送達，起義者的火力其實相當有限。英軍配備短身李-恩菲爾德步槍、維克斯機槍與路易斯式輕機槍，並有皇家野炮兵的十三磅野戰砲與十八磅榴彈砲；義勇軍另有手槍、少量手榴彈、剪鐵絲鉗與撬棍，用來拆鐵絲網與撬開街壘路障。馬車、載貨汽車與都柏林電車則是市區內跑得動的運輸工具。
kitsEn: The French percussion rifle of 1840 on the task sheet is the oldest end of the equipment spectrum in this Rising. It is a single-shot, rifled, muzzle-loading arm: the round is pushed in by the muzzle, a percussion cap is seated on the pan for each shot, and the great virtue of percussion over the flintlock is that the primer still fires in fog and rain. The wet, windy morning in Dublin on Monday the twenty-fourth of April was precisely the condition in which such an old rifle still kept its reliability. From the 1840 model the line ran on to the Gras pattern of 1874, and after the 1890s the type had left European armies for colonial guards and private stock. By 1916 the Irish Volunteers and the Citizen Army still held a number of these obsolete percussion rifles, mostly from nineteenth-century republican caches and veterans' club stores, handed out to detachments that had no shooting training or had not yet been issued a modern rifle. The work was done by modern bolt-action rifles: fifteen hundred Lee-Enfield pattern rifles bought in June 1914 at Howth from British NCOs, about nineteen hundred Mauser pattern rifles bought from Indian ordnance stores in the autumn of that year, and the German rifles that never arrived because the ship carrying them was intercepted in March. The insurgent firepower was therefore thin. The British had the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield, Vickers machine guns and Lewis light machine guns, together with a thirteen-pounder field gun and an eighteen-pounder howitzer of the Royal Field Artillery. The Volunteers had pistols, a few hand grenades, wire cutters and crowbars for cutting wire and levering open the street barricades. Carts, lorries and the Dublin trams were the only transport that could move inside the city.
tactics: 起義的行動計畫存在兩種版本：一種主張在星期一白天於都柏林市中心同時奪取要點，以民眾蜂起與德國援助為後盾；另一種主張以宣傳與武裝展示為主，貿然動手等於自取滅亡。復活節派最終採納前者，但計畫從未真正統一下來，行動被拆成互不協調的單獨奪點。星期一中午十二時三十分起義者同時出手：以皮爾斯與康諾利為首的一支先攻下都柏林郵政局，肯特率領的第三營佔領四法院，另一支切斷城市電報與電話線，其餘小隊在街口散發共和國宣言。奪點之後沒有全城總攻，也沒有第二步計畫。郵政局的防守最具代表性：起義者封住底層門口，架起機槍控制奧康奈爾街，樓上窗口由步槍手伏射，守軍以沙袋與門框為依托反擊。英軍戰術是英式街壘清剿：以連、營為單位封鎖路口，機槍佔據街角制高點，逐屋搜索殘餘，最後調來十三磅野戰砲向郵政局立面射擊，迫其放棄。起義方的弱點也很清楚：沒有統一指揮、沒有無線電，各點互不支援，多數射手只帶數發零散彈藥且未經射擊訓練，星期一狂風大雨使斗篷與紙包彈藥受潮，全城沒有撤退路線的安排。舊式雷管單發步槍在此更顯吃力：每分鐘只能射二至四發，移動中難以瞄準，正好遇上英軍固定射界與連續射擊最擅長的場面。
tacticsEn: There were two competing plans of action. One argued for seizing key points across central Dublin simultaneously during the day of the Monday, counting on the population rising and on German help; the other argued for propaganda and a show of force, on the grounds that premature action would be suicidal. The Easter group eventually took the first, but the plan was never properly coordinated and the operation broke down into a set of uncoordinated individual seizures. At half past twelve on the Monday the insurgents struck at several points at once: a party led by Pearse and Connolly took the GPO, Ceannt's Third Battalion occupied the Four Courts, another group cut the city's telegraph and telephone lines, and small parties distributed copies of the Proclamation at street corners. There was no general advance on the city afterwards, and no second stage to the plan. The defence of the Post Office is the clearest example. The insurgents sealed the ground-floor entrances, mounted machine guns to command O'Connell Street, and used the upper windows for aimed fire, while the garrison replied from behind sandbags and door frames. British method was that of a European street clearance: company and battalion cordons sealing each junction, machine guns holding the corners, houses searched one by one, and finally a thirteen-pounder field gun brought up to fire on the face of the GPO until the garrison gave way. The weaknesses of the Irish side are equally plain. There was no unified command and no wireless, so each position fought alone. Most riflemen carried only a handful of loose rounds and had no shooting training. The gale and rain of the Monday soaked the capes and the paper-wrapped ammunition, and no evacuation route had been planned anywhere in the city. The obsolete single-shot percussion rifles were worse still: two to four rounds a minute, and hard to aim while moving, precisely the situation in which British troops with fixed fields of fire and rapid fire were at their strongest.
data: 數字可以說明為何守不住。起義從四月二十四日至二十九日，前後六天，其中郵政局抵抗了五天，最後一批守軍約六十人於四月二十九日下午撤出大樓；四法院由星期一中午守到星期二下午，守軍約一百五十人，在砲擊下投降。兵力方面，義勇軍在都柏林可集結約一千三百人，公民軍約二百五十人，英軍與警察在起義開始時合計不足三千人，週末前增至約六千人。損失極不對稱：起義一方在整整一週內陣亡十六人、受傷六十四人，英軍與警察陣亡約八十人、受傷數百人。事後被捕的義勇軍成員約一千九百人，一九一六年有十六人被處決。武器消耗上，毛瑟與李-恩菲爾德式連發步槍每分鐘可射十至十五發，雷管單發步槍每分鐘只能發二至四發，等於把射擊密度壓到別人的三分之一。距離上，郵政局至四法院約一公里，至都柏林堡約一公里半，霍斯海灘距市中心約十三公里。砲兵方面，十三磅野戰砲的炮彈重約六公斤，末段對郵政局射擊數十發。軍火來源上，一九一四年六月購得的一千五百支英造步槍與同年約一千九百支毛瑟步槍，是起義者手中為數不多的近代步槍，而一九一六年三月底被截的一千五百支德造步槍並未到手。
dataEn: The figures explain why the Rising could not be held. It ran from the twenty-fourth to the twenty-ninth of April, six days in all, of which the Post Office resisted for five, its last garrison of about sixty men withdrawing from the building on the afternoon of the twenty-ninth. The Four Courts held from noon on the Monday until the afternoon of the Tuesday, some one hundred and fifty men surrendering under shellfire. On numbers of men, about thirteen hundred Volunteers could be mustered in Dublin and about two hundred and fifty Citizen Army men, against fewer than three thousand British soldiers and police at the outset, rising to about six thousand before the weekend. Losses were lopsided: over the full week sixteen insurgents were killed and sixty-four wounded, while about eighty British soldiers and police were killed and several hundred wounded. Some nineteen hundred Volunteers were arrested in the aftermath, and sixteen of them were executed during 1916. On rates of fire, a Mauser or Lee-Enfield repeating rifle could deliver ten to fifteen rounds a minute, whereas the single-shot percussion rifle managed two to four, holding the insurgent rate of fire to roughly a third of the enemy's. On distances, the GPO lay about a kilometre from the Four Courts and about a kilometre and a half from Dublin Castle, and Howth beach was some thirteen kilometres from the city centre. On the artillery, the thirteen-pounder field gun fired a shell of about six kilograms, and it was used against the GPO in the closing days. On the supply of arms, the fifteen hundred British rifles bought in June 1914 and the roughly nineteen hundred Mausers bought in the autumn of the same year were among the few modern rifles in Irish hands, and the fifteen hundred German rifles intercepted in late March 1916 never arrived.
cause: 打起上來的緣由有四層。第一層是自治法案：英國國會自一九一二年起屢次提出愛爾蘭自治方案，一九一四年被《溫莎宮法案》暫緩，一九一六年復活節前再度提交，愛爾蘭因此在政治上裂成兩半，支持自治的民族主義者與反對自治的北部聯合黨各持武裝，義勇軍正是在這種對立下成立並加速武裝化。第二層是新芬黨內部的分裂：一九一六年三月二十日例會上，以艾蒙・德瓦萊拉為首的議會派與以皮爾斯、康諾利、克拉克為首的復活節派分道揚鑣，武裝起義成為黨內路線之爭的產物。第三層是戰時壓力：糧食短缺、物價上漲，加上英國的徵兵令，青年面臨「加入英軍或加入愛爾蘭」的選擇，軍中士兵大批開小差返鄉。第四層是德國的招手：一戰中德國一直想削弱英國，德方曾許諾一旦愛爾蘭起事就提供援助與政治干涉，康諾利與博蘭的密使線把義勇軍與德國情報機構連在一起。宣言本身也說明目標：宣布愛爾蘭為獨立共和國，呼籲各國給予外交承認。
causeEn: There were four layers behind the outbreak. The first was the Home Rule bill: the British parliament had brought forward Irish home rule repeatedly since 1912, suspended it in 1914 under the Windsor House Act, and returned to it in the weeks before Easter 1916, so that Ireland split politically in two, with nationalists who wanted home rule and a northern unionist party each holding armed men; the Irish Volunteers arose out of that confrontation and armed themselves faster as it hardened. The second was the split inside Sinn Féin: at its conference on the twentieth of March 1916 the parliamentary wing of Éamon de Valera parted company with the Easter group of Pearse, Connolly and Clarke, and the insurrection became the product of that argument over strategy. The third was the pressure of war: short food supplies, rising prices and British conscription forced young men to choose between joining the British Army and joining Ireland, and soldiers were leaving the colours in large numbers. The fourth was the German invitation: Germany wanted to weaken Britain in the war, and had promised aid and political intervention once an Irish rising began, with the courier line run by Connolly and Harry Boland linking the Volunteers to German intelligence. The Proclamation states the objective plainly: to declare Ireland a sovereign republic and to call on other nations for diplomatic recognition.
impact: 軍事上失敗，政治上卻成了愛爾蘭民族認同的起點。起義後共和派逐漸整合：一九一七年新芬黨合併，德瓦萊拉當選黨主席；一九一九年一月國會宣布成立，自立議會通過《獨立宣言》，一場全面戰爭隨即展開；一九二二年愛爾蘭自由邦成立，大部分愛爾蘭島脫離英國聯邦。英國政府也調整政策：撤換部分都柏林駐軍指揮官，設立愛爾蘭問題委員會，一九一八年修改武器法，逐步停止追究民間持有步槍，同年十一月召開愛爾蘭國會會議。文化層面，一九一六年至一九二二年間出現被稱為愛爾蘭文學復興的寫作潮，蕭伯納、吉姆・謝立頓與佩達・奧唐奈的小說把起義經驗寫成政治文本。紀念制度亦由此建立：每年五月十六日的追思、以一九一六命名的街道與場所、一九二二年開始的儀式，到一九六六年五十週年時成為全國性事件。就戰術而言，起義示範了城市起義可以短期癱瘓一整座都柏林，但沒有民眾自發配合，沒有彈藥、人手與統一指揮，就無法把騷亂變成政權更替。
impactEn: It failed militarily and yet became the starting point of Irish national identity. The republican tendency gradually closed ranks afterwards: Sinn Féin was reunited in 1917 with de Valera elected president; in January 1919 the Dáil declared itself, the Assembly of Ireland adopted the Declaration of Independence, and a general war began; in 1922 the Irish Free State was established and most of the island left the United Kingdom. The British government adjusted its policy in turn, sacking some commanders in Ireland, setting up a commission on the Irish question, amending the arms law in 1918 so that the prosecution of private rifle ownership was gradually abandoned, and convening an Irish parliament in November of the same year. On the cultural plane, the years from 1916 to 1922 produced what is called the Irish literary renaissance, with Shaw, Jim Sheridan and Peadar O'Donnell turning the experience of the Rising into political writing. The commemorative practice was built out of the same event: the annual gathering on the sixteenth of May, streets and places named for 1916, and the ritual that began in 1922, by the fiftieth anniversary of 1966 a national event attended on a mass scale. Tactically the Rising demonstrated that an urban insurrection can paralyse an entire city for a few days, but without spontaneous support from the population, and without ammunition, manpower and unified command, disorder cannot be turned into a change of government.
result: 結果是起義被平定，而共和國並未成立。四月二十五日四法院在砲擊下投降，星期三起各處據點相繼失守，四月二十九日郵政局最後一批守軍接到撤退命令後退出大樓，凱瑟爾・布魯哈在退出後因傷重身亡，英軍當日傍晚完全控制市中心。共和國宣言從未取得任何國家的外交承認，試圖建立的政權只維持了五天。英軍隨後展開大規模拘捕，約一千九百名義勇軍成員入獄，十六人於五月十二日前後陸續被槍決，其後山喬伊監獄的絕食更令數百名在押者死於羈押期間，這場衝突的餘波一直延續到一九二三年。長期後果是路線的改變：起義把共和派從憲制改革推向武裝鬥爭，一九一九年開始的獨立戰爭最終迫使英國承認愛爾蘭大部分地區脫離聯邦，而北愛爾蘭仍留在英聯邦之內。一九一六年的失敗也留下三條清楚教訓——城市起義必須有全國性組織與外部援助作後盾，起義者需要統一指揮、可持續的彈藥補給與像樣的訓練，僅靠一份宣言與幾千支步槍不足以推翻一座城市的守備力量。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Rising was suppressed and that the republic was never established. The Four Courts surrendered under shellfire on the twenty-fifth of April; position after position fell through the middle of the week; and on the twenty-ninth the last garrison of the Post Office withdrew from the building on the order to stand down, Cathal Brugha dying of his wounds after the withdrawal, with British troops in complete control of the city centre by that evening. The Proclamation was never acknowledged by any state, and the regime it proclaimed lasted five days. The British then mounted large-scale arrests, some nineteen hundred Volunteers going to prison, sixteen of them shot in the days around the twelfth of May, and the hunger strike at Mountjoy Prison later killed several hundred prisoners in custody, so that the aftershocks of the week ran on until 1923. The long-term consequence was a change of line: the Rising drove the republican movement from constitutional reform towards armed struggle, and the war that began in 1919 eventually forced Britain to concede that most of Ireland would leave the United Kingdom, while the north remained inside it. The failure of 1916 also left three plain lessons. An urban insurrection needs a national organisation and outside support behind it; the insurgents need unified command, a sustainable supply of ammunition and proper training; and a proclamation together with a few thousand rifles is not enough to break the defence of a city.
